name: buaa-hep-pages-build
description: Root build adapter for Cloudflare Pages Git deployments of the frontend workspace.

scripts.postinstall: if [ ! -x frontend/node_modules/.bin/vite ]; then npm --prefix frontend ci; fi; mkdir -p node_modules/.bin; ln -sf ../../frontend/node_modules/.bin/playwright node_modules/.bin/playwright
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && rm -rf dist functions && cp -a frontend/dist dist && cp -a frontend/functions functions
